危险操作.original_context_sentence: In the branch that allows CRLF recognition, when '\r' is read and the cursor is not at the end, the old code uses a second c.read<char>() to inspect the next byte.

适用前提.check_zh: 在目标代码中存在与样本类似的按不足的条件验证输入或对象状态；受影响对象、长度/偏移、可达路径应逐项匹配；不能仅凭同名函数匹配。
适用前提.observed_input_and_state:
In the branch that allows CRLF recognition, when '\r' is read and the cursor is not at the end, the old code uses a second c.read<char>() to inspect the next byte. If that byte is not '\n', the loop continues, but the cursor has consumed two bytes while i increases only once. The loop condition i < buf.chainLength() therefore cannot guarantee that the cursor still has data when the next loop body reads. !c.isAtEnd() protects only the second read inside the branch, not the loop entry after synchronization has been lost. For example, with a buffer of "\rx" and maxLength_ > 1, the first iteration consumes all data, but the second iteration may still execute a read. In addition, the byte consumed for the test is not checked as b again, so a CRLF beginning at the following position may be missed. Whether the actual out-of-bounds attempt triggers an exception or causes a memory out-of-bounds access depends on the unprovided Cursor implementation.
Type description under current review: cursor and loop-index desynchronization, causing a read attempt beyond the logical buffer and missed terminator detection

安全反证.verification_goal_zh: 检查所有与安全性质相关的输入约束及分支一致性
安全反证.repair_observed_not_proof_of_any_other_c:
The recalculated diff shows that the substantive change is replacing the consuming c.read<char>() in the CRLF branch with *c.peekBytes().data(). Under the semantics that read advances the cursor and peekBytes does not, the order becomes: read the current byte, confirm that CRLF is allowed and the current byte is '\r', confirm that the cursor is not at the end, and then peek at the next byte. When the peek does not match, the next iteration still reads that byte, so each continuing iteration consumes one byte, consistent with the increment of i, thereby blocking the boundary failure and missed detection caused by the branch's extra consumption.
Repair mechanism description under current review: change consuming reads used to probe a terminator into a non-advancing peek, so a failed probe does not change the next input position and the loop index remains aligned with the number of consumed bytes.

适用前提.observed_input_and_state:
The old code indexes tree->nodes directly with tree->free_node_index, then writes branch[0], branch[1], and leaf of that node and increments the index. If the index has reached or exceeded the valid upper bound of the node storage, these initialization writes go out of bounds; the function imposes no index limit before taking the address or writing.

安全反证.verification_goal_zh: 写入前证明目标实际可写容量足够（含结束符）；分支容量应匹配
安全反证.repair_observed_not_proof_of_any_other_c:
Before taking the node address, after compares free_node_index with total_node_index. When the index is greater than or equal to the upper bound, it throws LIBRAW_EXCEPTION_IO_CORRUPT, blocking the subsequent address calculation, member writes, and index increment; when it is below the bound, the original execution order is retained.
Current review fix mechanism description: Before obtaining and initializing a node at the next free index, use the node count as an exclusive upper bound; throw immediately when the index reaches or crosses it, so the failure path neither accesses a node nor advances the free index.

危险操作.mechanism_zh: 从内存、缓冲区或索引位置读取数据
危险操作.source_code: int	old_desc_blocks;
危险操作.original_context_sentence: In the META_BG branch, old_desc_blocks is taken from s_first_meta_bg but is compared with that same source field; when the assignment preserves the value, the condition is always false and cannot ensure that the number written does not exceed fs->desc_blocks.

适用前提.check_zh: 在目标代码中存在与样本类似的从内存、缓冲区或索引位置读取数据；受影响对象、长度/偏移、可达路径应逐项匹配；不能仅凭同名函数匹配。
适用前提.observed_input_and_state:
In the META_BG branch, old_desc_blocks is taken from s_first_meta_bg but is compared with that same source field; when the assignment preserves the value, the condition is always false and cannot ensure that the number written does not exceed fs->desc_blocks. If s_first_meta_bg is greater than fs->desc_blocks and execution reaches the old_desc_blk write branch, the excessive old_desc_blocks is passed with group_ptr to io_channel_write_blk64. In the big-endian branch, group_shadow is explicitly allocated and copied using fs->desc_blocks * fs->blocksize; if the write interface reads the source according to the supplied block count, it may read beyond the end of that buffer. The SUPER_ONLY, MASTER_SB_ONLY, and old_desc_blk conditions control only whether writing occurs and do not constrain source-data length; checking retval after writing cannot block this read beforehand.
Current review type description: incorrect upper-bound check on block count, potentially causing an out-of-bounds source-buffer read during writing

安全反证.verification_goal_zh: 读取前验证偏移、长度、真实对象容量；检查加法溢出
安全反证.repair_observed_not_proof_of_any_other_c:
The declaration of old_desc_blocks changes from int to blk64_t, and the META_BG comparison changes from s_first_meta_bg to fs->desc_blocks. The code obtains the requested block count, limits a value above the descriptor-block count to fs->desc_blocks, and then passes it to the existing write call, making the count bound correspond to the descriptor storage range. The typedef and write-interface declaration are not provided, so this does not establish a specific type width or eliminate every conversion risk.
Current review fix mechanism description: Replace a self-comparison of a source field with a comparison against the actual storage capacity, constrain the count before the bulk operation, and adjust the count type at the same time; its representable range must still be confirmed from external type definitions.
